title: thelypteris negligens
intro: Thelypteris negligens, commonly known as the slender lady fern, is a species of fern in the family Thelypteridaceae. It is a type of vascular plant that has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits. The slender lady fern is said to possess therapeutic actions such as anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may help to alleviate symptoms of conditions such as arthritis and oxidative stress. The bioactive constituents of Thelypteris negligens include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, although further research is needed to fully understand its medicinal potential.
